description.raw:
'''Passive:''' '''Twisted Fate''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed. His [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] generate a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Stacked Deck'', stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, his next basic attack is empowered to consume them all to deal '''bonus''' magic damage, reduced to 50% against structures.

'''Twisted Fate''' gains maximum stacks of ''Stacked Deck'' upon [[death|respawning]].
description.text:
Passive: Twisted Fate gains  bonus attack speed. His basic attacks on-hit generate a stack of Stacked Deck, stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, his next basic attack is empowered to consume them all to deal bonus magic damage, reduced to 50% against structures.
Twisted Fate gains maximum stacks of Stacked Deck upon respawning.

notes.raw: * ''Stacked Deck'' can be [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] and/or missed if '''Twisted Fate''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]] (the on-hit effect is not consumed in either case) but cannot be [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] (the enhanced attack is consumed and the bonus damage is still applied). * As of patch [[V14.2]], '''Twisted Fate''' is intended to gain maximum stacks of ''Stacked Deck'' upon learning the ability, but currently does not.(bug) * The empowered attack will trigger against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]] but not [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]].
notes.text:
Stacked Deck can be dodged and/or missed if Twisted Fate is blinded (the on-hit effect is not consumed in either case) but cannot be blocked (the enhanced attack is consumed and the bonus damage is still applied).
As of patch V14.2, Twisted Fate is intended to gain maximum stacks of Stacked Deck upon learning the ability, but currently does not.(bug)
The empowered attack will trigger against structures but not wards.
